tweets.text:
Quick clarification on the post above:
Root Reborn’s basket and claiming infrastructure is now live, but validator curation is not enabled yet.

Root validators cannot currently set allocation weights — the on-chain toggle remains off, so every validator is running the same null strategy and dividends accrue in the subnet where they were earned.

For Root stakers, yield continues to accrue automatically, but it is no longer auto-claimed. Accrued dividends must now be claimed manually.

We’ll share another update when validator weight-setting is enabled.
